title: German Burger Sliders
description: A twist on traditional burgers, these German-inspired sliders feature a dense and flavorful patty topped with tangy sauerkraut and melted cheese.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, onion, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape into patties.
Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the buns on the grill.
Assemble the sliders by spreading a slice of Swiss cheese on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked patty, a spoonful of sauerkraut, and finally the top bun.
